citations.claim: first controller_force_limit violation occurs at step 1 (force 6.5 > fmax 5)
initial state at rest so force should be limited to fmax
energy after violating step consistent with over-limit force applied

counterfactual.change: Set controller noise 1 -> 0, keeping all else identical; predicts violation disappears if noise is added after / outside the force limiter.

explanation: Seeded sensor noise is applied to the controller command without respecting fmax. With kp=100, vcmd=20, fmax=5, noise=1, step 1 commands force 6.5 exceeding limit 5. Removing only noise (1->0) eliminates the violation, proving the limiter does not clamp the noisy command.
vision_note: The red controller body sits on the left side of the arena while the green waypoint is far away in the upper right. Between step 0 and step 1 the body shows essentially no visible movement.
